{{Top|leg}}
'''Tromig''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While commenting on the entry for the [[DL-22 blaster pistol]], Tromig noted that the weapon was easily modified; Tromig added a night [[Scope/Legends|scope]] and [[diagnostic chip]] to the weapon, allowing an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to run maintenance checks.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
